fields.location: Level 9, east bay, below the tower crane hook
fields.injuries: One worker to hospital; two others examined on site
fields.workStopped: Yes: all work on levels 8 to 10 and under the swing radius
fields.description: A curtain wall unit slipped from its sling during the pick and landed on the level 8 deck. A worker on the deck was struck by a fragment.
fields.immediateActions: Pick stopped, area cleared, 911 called at 08:54, first aid given, headcount started.
fields.notifications: Safety director, project executive. Owner and insurer not yet told. OSHA decision pending.
